F26_gate_coverage_scales_with_acquisitio.reading: A never-acquired county produces ONE verdict row. The other 64 rails emit no row at all, and a missing row is invisible where an unaccounted cell would be countable (ENFORCEMENT: every record starts with its full shape). So the gate refuses Dallas on the one rail it happens to evaluate and is silent on the rest. The protection scales with how much has already been acquired, which is backwards: the county most needing a refusal generates the fewest verdicts.
F26_gate_coverage_scales_with_acquisitio.notAContradictionOfP195: P-195's predicate is that no empty county EARNS A PASS, and Dallas earns none. This finding is about the width of the refusal surface, not its correctness. It is a separate row, not a reopening.

controlFixedWhileClosing.what: probe-close-gate's drift check was VACUOUS and is now fixed and proven in both directions.
controlFixedWhileClosing.how_found: By violation, not by reading. The OPS-24 program range in _catalog/plan_registry.json was extended with a second range (200-210) to hold rows carded after 198. The self-test check named 'GATED_RANGES equals the registry's OPS-23 and OPS-24 ranges' then PASSED, despite the hook's literal ranges no longer matching.
controlFixedWhileClosing.cause: The check read reg.programs[id].rows[0] — the FIRST range of each program only. Any additional range was structurally invisible to it. A check narrower than its name.
controlFixedWhileClosing.consequence_if_unfixed: Closes for P-200 and P-201 would have been ungated, exactly as P-169..P-174 were ungated before the OPS-24 teardown found that. The control built to stop that recurrence could not see it recurring.
controlFixedWhileClosing.fix: Ranges named per program (OPS23_RANGES, OPS24_RANGES) and composed; PREDICATE_DEBT derived from OPS24_RANGES instead of a hardcoded 13-long sequence; the comparison extracted as registryRangesMatch() over EVERY range. Four self-tests added including two that must FAIL (registry has a range the hook lacks; hook has a range the registry lacks) plus P-200-is-gated and P-199-is-not. All pass.
controlFixedWhileClosing.ranges_left_literal_deliberately: The hook still hardcodes its ranges so it never depends on a file it might fail to read. That was the original design intent and it is correct; the defect was the drift check, not the literals.
